The Sidecar Pattern边车模式

— PDF 第 39 页 —

The first single-node pattern is the sidecar pattern. The sidecar pattern is a single-node pattern made up of two containers. The first is the application container. It contains the core logic for the application. Without this container, the application would not exist. In addition to the application container, there is a sidecar container. The role of the sidecar is to augment and improve the application container, often without the application container's knowledge. In its simplest form, a sidecar container can be used to add functionality to a container that might otherwise be difficult to improve. Sidecar containers are coscheduled onto the same machine via an atomic container group, such as the pod API object in Kubernetes. In addition to being scheduled on the same machine, the application container and sidecar container share a number of resources, including parts of the filesystem, hostname, and network, and many other namespaces. A generic image of this sidecar pattern is shown in Figure 3-1.

第一个单节点模式是边车模式。边车模式是由两个容器组成的单节点模式。第一个是应用容器，它包含应用的核心逻辑；没有这个容器，应用就不复存在。除了应用容器之外，还有一个边车容器。边车的角色是增强和改进应用容器，而且往往在应用容器毫不知情的情况下进行。在最简单的形式下，边车容器可以用来为一个容器添加原本难以改进的功能。边车容器通过原子容器组（例如 Kubernetes 中的 Pod API 对象）被共同调度到同一台机器上。除了被调度到同一台机器之外，应用容器和边车容器还共享许多资源，包括文件系统的部分内容、主机名、网络以及其他许多命名空间。图 3-1 展示了这个边车模式的通用示意图。

— PDF 第 40 页 —

An Example Sidecar: Adding HTTPS to a Legacy Service一个边车示例：为遗留服务添加 HTTPS

Consider, for example, a legacy web service. Years ago, when it was built, internal network security was not as high a priority for the company, and thus, the application only services requests over unencrypted HTTP, not HTTPS. Due to recent security incidents, the company has mandated the use of HTTPS for all company websites. To compound the misery of the team sent to update this particular web service, the source code for this application was built with an old version of the company's build system, which no longer functions.

举例来说，设想一个遗留 Web 服务。多年前它被构建时，内部网络安全对公司而言还不是高优先级，因此该应用只通过未加密的 HTTP 服务请求，而非 HTTPS。由于最近的安全事件，公司要求所有公司网站必须使用 HTTPS。让负责更新这个 Web 服务的团队更加痛苦的是，这个应用的源代码是用公司旧版本构建系统构建的，而那个构建系统已经无法运行了。

Containerizing this HTTP application is simple enough: the binary can run in a container with a version of an old Linux distribution on top of a more modern kernel being run by the team's container orchestrator. However, the task of adding HTTPS to this application is significantly more challenging. The team is trying to decide between resurrecting the old build system versus porting the application's source code to the new build system, when one of the team members suggests that they use the sidecar pattern to resolve the situation more easily.

将这个 HTTP 应用容器化相当简单：二进制文件可以在一个容器中运行，容器内使用旧版 Linux 发行版，而内核则是团队容器编排器所运行的更新的内核。然而，为这个应用添加 HTTPS 的任务则要困难得多。团队正在权衡是复活旧构建系统，还是将应用源代码移植到新构建系统上，这时一位团队成员建议他们使用边车模式来更轻松地解决问题。

The application of the sidecar pattern to this situation is straightforward. The legacy web service can be configured to serve exclusively on localhost (127.0.0.1), which means that only services that share the local network with the server will be able to access the service. Normally, this wouldn't be a practical choice because it would mean that no one could access the web service. However, using the sidecar pattern, in addition to the legacy container, we will add an nginx sidecar container. This nginx container lives in the same network namespace as the legacy web application, so it can access the service that is running on localhost.

将边车模式应用到这个场景非常直接。遗留 Web 服务可以被配置为仅在 localhost（127.0.0.1）上提供服务，这意味着只有与服务器共享本地网络的服务才能访问该服务。通常情况下，这不是一个可行的选择，因为那样就没人能访问这个 Web 服务了。然而，使用边车模式，除了遗留容器之外，我们再添加一个 nginx 边车容器。这个 nginx 容器与遗留 Web 应用位于同一个网络命名空间中，因此它可以访问运行在 localhost 上的服务。

At the same time, this nginx service can terminate HTTPS traffic on the external IP address of the pod and proxy that traffic to the legacy web application (see Figure 3-2). Since this unencrypted traffic is only sent via the local loopback adapter inside the container group, the network security team is satisfied that the data is safe. Likewise, by using the sidecar pattern, the team has modernized a legacy application without having to figure out how to rebuild a new application to serve HTTPS. A similar form of this pattern can also be used to add automatic certificate rotation, or even authentication and authorization to legacy web applications that may not be easy to modify.

同时，这个 nginx 服务可以在 Pod 的外部 IP 地址上终止 HTTPS 流量，并将该流量代理到遗留 Web 应用（见图 3-2）。由于这种未加密流量仅通过容器组内部的本地回环适配器发送，网络安全团队对数据安全感到满意。同样，通过使用边车模式，团队现代化了一个遗留应用，而无需搞清楚如何重新构建一个新应用来提供 HTTPS 服务。这种模式的类似形式还可以用来为不易修改的遗留 Web 应用添加自动证书轮换，甚至添加认证与授权。

Dynamic Configuration with Sidecars使用边车实现动态配置

Simply proxying traffic into an existing application is not the only use for a sidecar. Another common example is configuration synchronization. Many older applications use a configuration file for parameterizing the application; this may be a raw text file or something more structured like TOML, XML, JSON, or YAML. Many preexisting applications were written to assume that this file was present on the filesystem and read their configuration from there. However, in a cloud native environment it is often quite useful to use an API for updating configuration stored elsewhere. This allows you to do a dynamic push of configuration information via an API instead of manually logging in to every server and updating the configuration file using imperative commands. The desire for such an API is driven both by ease of use as well as the ability to add automation like rollback, which makes configuring (and reconfiguring) safer and easier. Kubernetes supports ConfigMap resources for exactly this purpose. Similar to the case of HTTPS, new applications can be written with the expectation that configuration is a dynamic property that should be obtained using a cloud API, but adapting and updating an existing application can be significantly more challenging. Fortunately, the sidecar pattern again can be used to provide new functionality that augments a legacy application without changing the existing application. For the sidecar pattern shown in Figure 3-3, there again are two containers: the container that is the serving application and the container that is the configuration manager. The two containers are grouped together into a pod, where they share a directory between themselves. This shared directory is where the configuration file is maintained.

仅仅将流量代理到已有应用并不是边车的唯一用途。另一个常见例子是配置同步。许多老旧应用使用配置文件来参数化应用；这可能是一个纯文本文件，或者更结构化的格式如 TOML、XML、JSON 或 YAML。许多既有应用在编写时假设这个文件存在于文件系统中，并从那里读取配置。然而，在云原生环境中，使用 API 来更新存储在其他地方的配置往往非常有用。这让你可以通过 API 动态推送配置信息，而不是手动登录每台服务器并用命令式命令更新配置文件。对这种 API 的需求既来自易用性，也来自添加自动化（如回滚）的能力，这让配置（和重新配置）更安全、更简单。Kubernetes 正是出于这个目的支持 ConfigMap 资源。与 HTTPS 的情况类似，新应用可以在编写时就将配置视为一种动态属性，应通过云 API 获取；但适配和更新一个已有应用则要困难得多。幸运的是，边车模式再次可以用来提供新功能，在不修改已有应用的情况下增强遗留应用。对于图 3-3 所示的边车模式，同样有两个容器：提供服务的应用容器和配置管理器容器。这两个容器被组合到一个 Pod 中，它们之间共享一个目录。这个共享目录就是配置文件被维护的地方。

When the legacy application starts, it loads its configuration from the filesystem, as expected. This configuration is placed into the filesystem using a ConfigMap volume which places the current contents of a ConfigMap resource at a particular location in

当遗留应用启动时，它按预期从文件系统加载配置。这个配置是通过 ConfigMap 卷放置到文件系统中的，ConfigMap 卷会将 ConfigMap 资源的当前内容放到文件系统中的特定位置。

— PDF 第 42 页 —

the filesystem. When the configuration manager starts, it examines the configuration API and looks for differences between the local filesystem and the configuration stored in the API. If there are differences, the configuration manager downloads the new configuration to the local filesystem and signals to the legacy application that it should reconfigure itself with this new configuration. The actual mechanism for this notification varies by application. Some applications actually watch the configuration file for changes, while others respond to a SIGHUP signal. In extreme cases, the configuration manager may send a SIGKILL signal to abort the legacy application. Once aborted, the container orchestration system will restart the legacy application, at which point it will load its new configuration. As with adding HTTPS to an existing application, this pattern illustrates how the sidecar pattern can help adapt pre-existing applications to more cloud native scenarios.

当配置管理器启动时，它会检查配置 API，并查找本地文件系统与 API 中存储的配置之间的差异。如果存在差异，配置管理器会将新配置下载到本地文件系统，并通知遗留应用应使用这个新配置重新配置自身。这种通知的实际机制因应用而异。有些应用会监视配置文件的变化，而另一些则响应 SIGHUP 信号。在极端情况下，配置管理器可能发送 SIGKILL 信号来中止遗留应用。一旦中止，容器编排系统会重启遗留应用，此时它将加载新配置。与为已有应用添加 HTTPS 一样，这个模式展示了边车模式如何帮助将既有应用适配到更云原生的场景。

Modular Application Containers模块化应用容器

At this point, you might be forgiven if you thought that the sole reason for the sidecar pattern to exist was to adapt legacy applications where you no longer wanted to make modifications to the original source code. While this is a common use case for the pattern, there are many other motivations for designing things using sidecars. One of the other main advantages of using the sidecar pattern is modularity and reuse of the components used as sidecars. In deploying any real-world, reliable application, there is functionality that you need for debugging or other management of the application, such as giving a readout of all of the different processes using resources in the container, similar to the top command-line tool.

读到这里，如果你认为边车模式存在的唯一理由就是适配那些你不再想修改原始源代码的遗留应用，那也情有可原。虽然这是该模式的常见用例，但使用边车进行设计还有许多其他动机。使用边车模式的另一个主要优势是作为边车的组件的模块化与复用。在部署任何真实世界的可靠应用时，你都需要一些用于调试或其他应用管理的功能，例如提供容器中所有使用资源的不同进程的读数，类似于 top 命令行工具。

One approach to providing this introspection is to require that each developer implement an HTTP /topz interface that provides a readout of resource usage. To make this easier, you might implement this webhook as a language-specific plug-in that the developer could simply link into their application. But even if done this way, the developer would be forced to choose to link it in, and your organization would be forced to implement the interface for every language it wants to support. Unless done with extreme rigor, this approach is bound to lead to variations among languages as well as a lack of support for the functionality when using new languages. Instead, this topz functionality can be deployed as a sidecar container that shares the process-ID (PID) namespace with the application container. This topz container can introspect all running processes and provide a consistent user interface. Moreover, you can use the orchestration system to automatically add this container to all applications deployed via the orchestration system to ensure that there is a consistent set of tools available for all applications running in your infrastructure.

提供这种内省的一种方法是要求每位开发者实现一个 HTTP /topz 接口，提供资源使用情况的读数。为了简化，你可以将这个 webhook 实现为特定语言的插件，开发者只需将其链接到自己的应用中即可。但即便如此，开发者仍需选择是否链接它，而你的组织也不得不为想要支持的每种语言实现该接口。除非极其严谨，否则这种方法必然导致不同语言之间的差异，以及在使用新语言时缺乏对该功能的支持。相反，这个 topz 功能可以作为一个边车容器部署，与应用容器共享进程 ID（PID）命名空间。这个 topz 容器可以内省所有运行中的进程，并提供一致的用户界面。此外，你可以使用编排系统自动将这个容器添加到通过编排系统部署的所有应用中，以确保基础设施中运行的所有应用都有一套一致的工具可用。

Of course, as with any technical choice, there are trade-offs between this modular container-based pattern and rolling your own code into your application. The library-based approach is always going to be somewhat less tailored to the specifics of your

当然，与任何技术选择一样，这种基于模块化容器的模式与将代码自行编入应用之间存在权衡。基于库的方法总是在一定程度上不够贴合你的

— PDF 第 43 页 —

application. This means that it may be less efficient in terms of performance, or that the API may require some adaptation to fit into your environment. I would compare these trade-offs to the difference between buying off-the-rack clothing versus bespoke fashion. The bespoke fashion will always fit you better, but it will take longer to arrive and cost more to acquire. As with clothes, for most of us it makes sense to buy the more general-purpose solution when it comes to coding. Of course, if your application demands extremes in terms of performance, you can always choose the handwritten solution.

应用的具体需求。这意味着它在性能上可能效率较低，或者 API 可能需要一些适配才能融入你的环境。我会把这些权衡比作买成衣与定制服装之间的区别。定制服装总是更合身，但交付时间更长、价格更贵。就像衣服一样，对我们大多数人来说，在写代码时购买更通用的解决方案是合理的。当然，如果你的应用对性能有极致要求，你总是可以选择手写方案。

Hands On: Deploying the topz Container实战：部署 topz 容器

To see the topz sidecar in action, you first need to deploy some other container to act as the application container. Choose an existing application that you are running and deploy it using Docker:

要查看 topz 边车的实际效果，你首先需要部署另一个容器作为应用容器。选择一个你正在运行的已有应用，使用 Docker 部署它：

$ docker run -d

After you run that image, you will receive the identifier for that specific container. It will look something like: cccf82b85000… If you don't have it, you can always look it up using the docker ps command, which will show all currently running containers. Assuming you have stashed that value in an environment variable named APP_ID, you can then run the topz container in the same PID namespace using:

运行该镜像后，你将收到该特定容器的标识符。它看起来像这样：cccf82b85000……如果你没有记住它，随时可以用 docker ps 命令查找，它会显示所有当前正在运行的容器。假设你已将该值存放在名为 APP_ID 的环境变量中，你就可以在同一个 PID 命名空间中运行 topz 容器：

$ docker run --pid=container:${APP_ID} \
    -p 8080:8080 \
    brendanburns/topz:db0fa58 \
    /server --addr=0.0.0.0:8080

This will launch the topz sidecar in the same PID namespace as the application container. Note that you may need to change the port that the sidecar uses for serving if your application container is also running on port 8080. Once the sidecar is running, you can visit http://localhost:8080/topz to get a complete readout of the processes that are running in the application container and their resource usage.

这将在与应用容器相同的 PID 命名空间中启动 topz 边车。注意，如果你的应用容器也在 8080 端口上运行，你可能需要更改边车使用的服务端口。边车运行后，你可以访问 http://localhost:8080/topz 来获取应用容器中正在运行的进程及其资源使用情况的完整读数。

You can mix this sidecar with any other existing container to easily get a view into how the container is using its resources via a web interface.

你可以将这个边车与任何其他已有容器组合使用，通过 Web 界面轻松查看该容器如何使用其资源。

Building a Simple PaaS with Sidecars用边车构建简单的 PaaS

The sidecar pattern can be used for more than adaptation and monitoring. It can also be used as a means to implement the complete logic for your application in a simplified, modular manner. As an example, imagine building a simple platform as a service (PaaS) built around the git workflow. Once you deploy this PaaS, simply pushing new code up to a Git repository results in that code being deployed to the running

边车模式不仅可以用于适配和监控。它还可以用来以简化、模块化的方式实现应用的完整逻辑。举例来说，想象构建一个围绕 Git 工作流的简单平台即服务（PaaS）。一旦部署了这个 PaaS，只需将新代码推送到 Git 仓库，代码就会被部署到正在运行的

— PDF 第 44 页 —

servers. We'll see how the sidecar pattern makes building this PaaS remarkably straightforward.

服务器上。我们将看到边车模式如何让构建这个 PaaS 变得异常简单。

As previously stated, in the sidecar pattern there are two containers: the main application container and the sidecar. In our simple PaaS application, the main container is a Node.js server that implements a web server. The Node.js server is instrumented so that it automatically reloads the server when new files are updated. This is accomplished with the nodemon tool.

如前所述，边车模式中有两个容器：主应用容器和边车。在我们的简单 PaaS 应用中，主容器是一个实现了 Web 服务器的 Node.js 服务器。这个 Node.js 服务器被埋点，以便在新文件更新时自动重载服务器。这是通过 nodemon 工具实现的。

The sidecar container shares a filesystem with the main application container and runs a simple loop that synchronizes the filesystem with an existing Git repository:

边车容器与主应用容器共享文件系统，并运行一个简单循环，将文件系统与已有 Git 仓库同步：

#!/bin/bash

while true; do
  git pull
  sleep 10
done

Obviously, this script could be more complex, pulling from a specific branch instead of simply from HEAD. It is left purposefully simple to improve the readability of this example.

显然，这个脚本可以更复杂，比如从特定分支拉取而不是简单地从 HEAD 拉取。这里故意保持简单，以提高示例的可读性。

The Node.js application and Git synchronization sidecar are coscheduled and deployed together to implement our simple PaaS (Figure 3-4). Once deployed, every time new code is pushed to a Git repository, the code is automatically updated by the sidecar and reloaded by the server.

Node.js 应用和 Git 同步边车被共同调度并一起部署，以实现我们的简单 PaaS（图 3-4）。部署后，每当新代码被推送到 Git 仓库时，代码会被边车自动更新，并由服务器重新加载。

— PDF 第 45 页 —

Designing Sidecars for Modularity and Reusability为模块化与可复用性设计边车

In all of the examples of sidecars that we have detailed throughout this chapter, one of the most important themes is that every one was a modular, reusable artifact. To be successful, the sidecar should be reusable across a wide variety of applications and deployments. By achieving modular reuse, sidecars can dramatically speed up the building of your application.

在本章详述的所有边车示例中，最重要的主题之一是：每一个都是模块化、可复用的制品。要取得成功，边车应该能够跨各种应用和部署复用。通过实现模块化复用，边车可以极大地加速你的应用构建。

However, this modularity and reusability, just like achieving modularity in high-quality software development, requires focus and discipline. In particular, you need to focus on developing three areas:

然而，这种模块化与可复用性，就像在高质量软件开发中实现模块化一样，需要专注与自律。特别是，你需要专注于发展三个方面：

  • Parameterizing your containers为你的容器设置参数
  • Creating the API surface of your container创建容器的 API 接口面
  • Documenting the operation of your container为容器的操作编写文档

Once you follow these common approaches, you will develop sidecars that can be reused across a wide variety of applications.

一旦你遵循这些通用方法，你就能开发出可跨各种应用复用的边车。

Parameterized Containers参数化容器

Parameterizing your containers is the most important thing you can do to make your containers modular and reusable regardless of whether they are sidecars or not, though sidecars and other add-on containers are especially important to parameterize.

为容器设置参数是使容器模块化、可复用的最重要的事情——无论它们是否是边车都如此，尽管边车和其他附加容器尤其需要参数化。

What do I mean when I say "parameterize"? Consider your container as a function in your program. How many parameters does it have? Each parameter represents an input that can customize a generic container to a specific situation. Consider, for example, the SSL add-on sidecar deployed previously. To be generally useful, it likely needs at least two parameters: the first is the name of the certificate being used to provide SSL, and the other is the port of the "legacy" application server running on localhost. Without these parameters, it is hard to imagine this sidecar container being usable for a broad array of applications. Similar parameters exist for all of the other sidecars described in this chapter.

我说的“参数化”是什么意思？把你的容器想象成程序中的一个函数。它有多少个参数？每个参数代表一个输入，可以将一个通用容器定制到特定场景。例如，考虑之前部署的 SSL 附加边车。要做到通用可用，它可能至少需要两个参数：第一个是用于提供 SSL 的证书名称，另一个是运行在 localhost 上的“遗留”应用服务器的端口。没有这些参数，很难想象这个边车容器能广泛用于各种应用。本章描述的所有其他边车也都有类似的参数。

Now that we know the parameters we want to expose, how do we actually expose them to users, and how do we consume them inside the container. There are two ways in which such parameters can be passed to your container: through environment variables or the command line. Though either is feasible, I have a general preference for passing parameters via environment variables. An example of passing such parameters to a sidecar container is:

现在我们知道了想要暴露的参数，如何将它们实际暴露给用户，又如何在容器内部使用它们呢？有两种方式可以将这些参数传递给你的容器：通过环境变量或命令行。虽然两种方式都可行，但我总体上更倾向于通过环境变量传递参数。将这些参数传递给边车容器的一个例子是：

docker run -e=PORT= -d
— PDF 第 46 页 —

Of course, delivering values into the container is only part of the battle. The other part is actually using these variables inside the container. Typically, to do that, a simple shell script is used that loads the environment variables supplied with the sidecar container and either adjusts the configuration files or parameterizes the underlying application.

当然，将值传递进容器只是战斗的一半。另一半是在容器内部实际使用这些变量。通常，为此会使用一个简单的 shell 脚本，它加载边车容器提供的环境变量，然后调整配置文件或参数化底层应用。

For example, you might pass in the certificate path and port as environment variables:

例如，你可以将证书路径和端口作为环境变量传入：

docker run -e=PROXY_PORT=8080 -e=CERTIFICATE_PATH=/path/to/cert.crt ...

In your container, you would use those variables to configure an nginx.conf file that points the web server to the correct file and proxy location.

在你的容器中，你会使用这些变量来配置 nginx.conf 文件，将 Web 服务器指向正确的文件和代理位置。

Define Each Container's API定义每个容器的 API

Given that you are parameterizing your containers, it is obvious that your containers are defining a "function" that is called whenever the container is executed. This function is clearly a part of the API that is defined by your container, but there are other parts to this API as well, including calls that the container will make to other services as well as traditional HTTP or other APIs that the container provides.

既然你在为容器设置参数，显然你的容器正在定义一个“函数”，每当容器执行时就会被调用。这个函数显然是容器所定义 API 的一部分，但这个 API 还有其他部分，包括容器将对其他服务发出的调用，以及容器提供的传统 HTTP 或其他 API。

As you think about defining modular, reusable containers, it is important to realize that all aspects of how your container interacts with its world are part of the API defined by that reusable container. As in the world of microservices, these microcontainers rely on APIs to ensure that there is a clean separation between the main application container and the sidecar. Additionally, the API exists to ensure that all consumers of the sidecar will continue to work correctly as subsequent versions are released. Likewise, having a clean API for a sidecar enables the sidecar developer to move more quickly since they have a clear definition (and hopefully unit tests) for the services they provide as a part of the sidecar.

当你思考如何定义模块化、可复用的容器时，重要的是要认识到：你的容器与外部世界交互的方方面面，都是这个可复用容器所定义 API 的一部分。正如在微服务世界中一样，这些微容器依赖 API 来确保主应用容器与边车之间有清晰的分离。此外，API 的存在还确保边车的所有消费者在后续版本发布时能继续正常工作。同样，为边车提供干净的 API 使边车开发者能更快地推进，因为他们对作为边车一部分所提供的服务有清晰的定义（希望还有单元测试）。

To see a concrete example of why this API surface area is important, consider the configuration management sidecar we discussed earlier. A useful configuration for this sidecar might be UPDATE_FREQUENCY, which indicates how often the configuration should be synchronized with the filesystem. It is clear that if, at some later time, the name of the parameter is changed to UPDATE_PERIOD, this change would be a violation of the sidecar's API and clearly would break it for some users.

要具体理解这个 API 接口面为何重要，回想一下我们之前讨论的配置管理边车。这个边车的一个有用配置可能是 UPDATE_FREQUENCY，它表示配置应多久与文件系统同步一次。显然，如果在以后某个时间，这个参数的名称被改为 UPDATE_PERIOD，这个变更就违反了边车的 API，并且显然会破坏某些用户的使用。

While that example is obvious, even more subtle changes can break the sidecar API. Imagine, for example, that UPDATE_FREQUENCY originally took a number in seconds. Over time and with feedback from users, the sidecar developer determined that specifying seconds for large time values (e.g., minutes) was annoying users and changed the parameter to accept strings (10m, 5s, etc.). Because old parameter values (e.g., 10, for 10 seconds) won't parse in this new scheme, this is a breaking API change. Suppose still that the developer anticipated this but made values without units parse to milliseconds where they had previously parsed to seconds. Even this change,

虽然这个例子很明显，但更微妙的变更也可能破坏边车 API。例如，设想 UPDATE_FREQUENCY 最初接受以秒为单位的数字。随着时间推移和用户反馈，边车开发者认为对于较大的时间值（例如分钟）指定秒数让用户感到烦恼，于是将参数改为接受字符串（10m、5s 等）。因为旧的参数值（例如 10，表示 10 秒）在这个新方案中无法解析，这就是一个破坏性的 API 变更。再假设开发者预见到了这一点，但将不带单位的值解析为毫秒，而之前它们解析为秒。即使这个变更

— PDF 第 47 页 —

despite not leading to an error, is a breaking API change for the sidecar since it will lead to significantly more frequent configuration checks and correspondingly more load on the cloud configuration server.

不会导致错误，对边车来说仍然是一个破坏性的 API 变更，因为它会导致配置检查的频率显著增加，从而相应地增加云配置服务器的负载。

I hope this discussion has shown you that for true modularity, you need to be very conscious of the API that your sidecar provides, and that "breaking" changes to that API may not always be as obvious as changing the name of a parameter.

我希望这段讨论已经让你明白：要实现真正的模块化，你需要非常清楚你的边车所提供的 API，而且对该 API 的“破坏性”变更并不总是像更改参数名称那样明显。

Documenting Your Containers为容器编写文档

By now, you've seen how you can parameterize your sidecar containers to make them modular and reuseable. You've learned about the importance of maintaining a stable API to ensure that you don't break sidecars for your users. But there's one final step to building modular, reusable containers: ensuring that people can use them in the first place.

到目前为止，你已经看到了如何为边车容器设置参数以使其模块化、可复用。你也了解了维护稳定 API 的重要性，以确保不会破坏用户使用的边车。但构建模块化、可复用容器还有最后一步：确保人们首先能够使用它们。

As with software libraries, the key to building something truly useful is explaining how to use it. There is little good in building a flexible, reliable modular container if no one can figure out how to use it. Sadly, there are few formal tools available for documenting container images, but there are some best practices you can use to accomplish this.

与软件库一样，构建真正有用的东西的关键是解释如何使用它。如果没人能搞清楚如何使用，构建一个灵活、可靠的模块化容器就没有什么意义。遗憾的是，可用于记录容器镜像的正式工具很少，但你可以遵循一些最佳实践来做到这一点。

For every container image, the most obvious place to look for documentation is the Dockerfile from which the container was built. There are some parts of the Dockerfile that already document how the container works. One example of this is the EXPOSE directive, which indicates the ports that the image listens on. Even though EXPOSE is not necessary, it is a good practice to include it in your Dockerfile and also to add a comment that explains what exactly is listening on that port. For example:

对于每个容器镜像，最明显的文档查找位置就是构建该容器的 Dockerfile。Dockerfile 中有些部分已经记录了容器的工作方式。一个例子是 EXPOSE 指令，它指示镜像监听的端口。虽然 EXPOSE 不是必需的，但在 Dockerfile 中包含它并添加注释说明到底是什么在监听该端口是一个好的实践。例如：

...

# Main web server runs on port 8080
EXPOSE 8080
...

Additionally, if you use environment variables to parameterize your container, you can use the ENV directive to set default values for those parameters as well as document their usage:

此外，如果你使用环境变量来参数化容器，你可以使用 ENV 指令为这些参数设置默认值，并记录它们的用法：

...

# The PROXY_PORT parameter indicates the port on localhost to redirect
# traffic to.
ENV PROXY_PORT 8000
...
— PDF 第 48 页 —

Finally, you should always use the LABEL directive to add metadata for your image; for example, the maintainer's email address, web page, and version of the image:

最后，你应该始终使用 LABEL 指令为镜像添加元数据；例如，维护者的电子邮件地址、网页和镜像版本：

...

LABEL "org.opencontainers.image.vendor"="name@company.com"
LABEL "org.opencontainers.image.url"="http://images.company.com/my-cool-image"
LABEL "org.opencontainers.image.version"="1.0.3"
...

The names for these labels are drawn from the schema established by the Open Containers Initiative. The Open Containers Initiative (OCI) is the specification body which maintains the definition of what it means to be a container image. A part of that specification is the definition of a shared set of annotations/labels. By using a common taxonomy of image labels, multiple different tools can rely on the same meta information in order to visualize, monitor, and correctly use an application. By adopting shared terms, you can use the set of tools developed in the community without modifying your image. Of course, you can also add whatever additional labels make sense in the context of your image.

这些标签的名称取自开放容器倡议（Open Containers Initiative）建立的模式。开放容器倡议（OCI）是维护“容器镜像”定义的规范机构。该规范的一部分是对一组共享注解/标签的定义。通过使用镜像标签的通用分类法，多个不同工具可以依赖相同的元信息来可视化、监控和正确使用一个应用。通过采用共享术语，你可以使用社区开发的工具集而无需修改你的镜像。当然，你也可以在镜像的上下文中添加任何有意义的额外标签。

Summary小结

Over the course of this chapter, we've introduced the sidecar pattern for combining containers on a single machine. In the sidecar pattern, a sidecar container augments and extends an application container to add functionality. Sidecars can be used to update existing legacy applications when changing the application is too costly. Likewise, they can be used to create modular utility containers that standardize implementations of common functionality. These utility containers can be reused in a large number of applications, increasing consistency and reducing the cost of developing each application. Subsequent chapters introduce other single-node patterns that demonstrate other uses for modular, reusable containers.

在本章中，我们介绍了在单台机器上组合容器的边车模式。在边车模式中，边车容器增强和扩展应用容器以添加功能。当修改应用的成本过高时，边车可用于更新已有的遗留应用。同样，它们可用于创建模块化的实用容器，将常见功能的实现标准化。这些实用容器可以在大量应用中复用，提高一致性并降低每个应用的开发成本。后续章节介绍其他单节点模式，展示模块化、可复用容器的其他用途。
